facts.note: At nine the watches were shown. Ruedi's was exact, Dr Vauthier's was two minutes ahead, and Girard would not take his out of his pocket.

The hall clock struck ten while the regulator showed twelve minutes to ten, and the master said what he always says about that clock. When the temple struck ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
He sent her downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten. The regulator was running and he was well. She went straight to the kitchen.
That afternoon she saw the master in the kitchen with Rosa's clock in his hands, laughing, and did not ask why.
In the kitchen she looked at Rosa's clock when Madame's piano began and it showed two minutes to eleven. When the piano stopped it showed eleven minutes past eleven.
She stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
